definitions.homeReady: First enabled visible full-story button, formal save state saved, then two native animation frames; measured from navigation time origin.
definitions.introReady: Actual full-story button click to paused intro with ready Canvas, nonempty pixel buffer and enabled play control, then two native animation frames.
definitions.cold: Fresh browser context per sample; pattern=fresh has no project; explicit --pattern preloads only a fixture draft with story=null in IndexedDB via study.html before recording requests. HTTP cache disabled through CDP, Service Workers blocked, no pre-existing project for pattern=fresh. OS/server filesystem caches are not cleared.
definitions.network: CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions; 5Mbps is 625000 bytes/s aggregated download and upload, latency 150ms request-to-response-header minimum. No CPU throttle.
definitions.imageFontBudget: Image/font HTTP response encoded body sizes, verified against matching ResourceTiming, HTTP Content-Length and the built artifact; Playwright response.body may be empty for consumed fetches and is never treated as zero transfer. Unique URLs requested from navigation through first intro ready. Includes resources loaded ahead for later shots within that intro. Inline SVG is part of HTML/JS, not a separate image transfer.

limitations: This host and Chromium emulation are not physical phones/IE/Safari or a remote deployment.
Startup is measured without autoplay/music/WebGL; real FPS and full performance duration are outside this probe.
PNG compatibility may exceed the image/font budget; any such failure is retained, not reclassified as a pass.
The 2s/5s targets refer to home interaction; intro click-to-ready is reported separately without silently adopting that as a specified target.
